device: src/pitch.py, YIN, 50 ms frames, 10 ms hop

behaviours.statement: the largest frame-to-frame pitch jumps are tracker artefacts -- a near-doubling or a halving -- and not voices.  A label taken from the biggest jump is a label taken from an artefact.

measurement.note: see the pause study's free-corpus slope tail: +344 st/s is not a slope, it is an octave error inside one 300 ms window

behaviours.provenance: docs/research/F0-SPEAKER-CHANGE.md reports one octave artefact and seven of thirteen subharmonic artefacts in one cell; the pause study's free corpus reaches +344 st/s
